files.content:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: podinfo
spec:
  replicas: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: podinfo
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: podinfo
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: podinfo
          image: ghcr.io/stefanprodan/podinfo:6.7.1
          ports:
            - containerPort: 9898
        - name: exporter
          image: ghcr.io/example-org/podinfo-exporter:0.4.2
